decisions.reason: The source establishes a setup procedure for one new MeetAlfred campaign but does not identify it as a silent-lead follow-up campaign or change follow-up recirculation behavior.
The source does not identify the new campaign as an email campaign or change the requirement for automated email campaigns.
The source does not identify the new campaign as a LinkedIn campaign or alter LinkedIn campaign automation behavior.
Creating a new campaign and copied Zap neither changes nor cancels the existing test-account, campaign-preservation, or lead-safety policies.
The campaign-specific setup does not change the requirement that the existing MeetAlfred integration remain connected.
The source configures a campaign and Zap but does not change MeetAlfred account setup or subscription-plan state.

The copied and published Zap is campaign-specific setup consistent with the existing Zapier-based synchronization requirement; it does not change the sync direction, object, integration method, or automatic contact-addition rule.
The source does not mention campaign email infrastructure or change which platforms the campaign email must integrate with.
Copying and configuring a campaign-specific Zap does not change the Zapier account setup, subscription plan, or add-on selection.
The new campaign workflow does not change HubSpot Lead Status mappings for MeetAlfred replies or accepted LinkedIn connections.
The source describes operational campaign setup and does not change the direction or contents of the CRM data-flow map deliverable.
Creating a MeetAlfred campaign and configuring its Zap does not change the requirement for creating and managing lead-category lists in HubSpot.
